name: URL Canonicalizer
description: Resolves redirects to canonical URLs. Sends HEAD requests to each URL and replaces it with the final destination if redirected (301/302/307/308). Catches www/non-www, HTTP/HTTPS, path rewrites, and vanity URL redirects before they reach scraping.
usage_notes: Run after url-dedup and before url-filter. Makes one HEAD request per URL to detect redirects. URLs that redirect are replaced with their final destination. Dead URLs (timeout, DNS failure) are kept unchanged — url-filter handles liveness checks. DEFAULT (v1) BEHAVIOR IS AUTO-EXECUTE INCOMPATIBLE: redirected items are emitted flagged (status=redirected), and step<6 auto-approval excludes flagged items, so under auto-execute the rewrite is never applied; meanwhile the unchanged re-emits carry only 5 whitelisted fields and replace their pool rows wholesale, destroying provenance (found_via, link_text, source attribution). Set v2_behavior=true for auto-execute runs: redirects are emitted unflagged with a full field-spread and applied as an add+remove pair by the transform operation; unchanged rows are not emitted and pass through the pool untouched. v2_behavior is the intended configuration for the v3 template's R1 reinsertion; v1 default is kept only for byte-identical behavior under the live v1 template.

options.name: request_timeout
options.label: Request timeout (ms)
options.description: Timeout per HEAD request in milliseconds.

options.name: concurrency
options.label: Concurrent requests
options.description: How many HEAD requests to send in parallel.

options.name: v2_behavior
options.label: v2 behavior (auto-execute compatible)
options.description: Emit redirects unflagged with a full field-spread (all incoming fields survive) so auto-approval applies the URL rewrite as an add+remove pair; unchanged rows are not emitted and pass through the pool untouched. Leave false only for the legacy v1 template flow (flagged redirects for manual review; 5-field whitelist emit).
